title: RGA
description: The RGA summary: one point per Save, from rga_saves and rga_summary (docs/drivers/rga.md, 'Data'). Spectra are never in the database - each Save is a JSON file in data/rga/. Edit in the UI, then tools/save_dashboard.py --save.

list.name: mass
list.label: mass (amu)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT mass FROM rga_summary ORDER BY 1

query.query: SELECT DISTINCT mass FROM rga_summary ORDER BY 1

list.name: recipe
list.label: recipe
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT recipe FROM rga_saves ORDER BY 1

query.query: SELECT DISTINCT recipe FROM rga_saves ORDER BY 1

panels.description: One point per Save (rga_summary, the mean of its scans): the largest value from 0.25 amu below to 0.45 amu above each mass. Not a continuous measurement - lines only join Saves. 131 is not shown: it is mostly C3F5+ from PTFE; read xenon from 129 and 132. EM values are relative while the EM gain is uncalibrated (devices.yaml em_gain_calibrated), so the detector selector defaults to Faraday.
panels.title: Ion current per mass

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.t AS time, CASE s.mass WHEN 2 THEN '02 H2' WHEN 4 THEN '04 He' WHEN 18 THEN '18 H2O' WHEN 28 THEN '28 N2/CO' WHEN 32 THEN '32 O2' WHEN 40 THEN '40 Ar' WHEN 44 THEN '44 CO2' WHEN 69 THEN '69 CF3 (PTFE)' WHEN 129 THEN '129 Xe' WHEN 132 THEN '132 Xe' ELSE s.mass::text END AS metric, s.current_a AS value
FROM rga_summary s JOIN rga_saves v ON v.file = s.file
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.t) AND s.mass IN ($mass) AND v.recipe IN ($recipe) AND coalesce(v.detector, 'Faraday') IN ($detector) AND s.current_a > 0
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: current / the analyser's ppSensitivityFactor, converted to mbar: N2-equivalent, not corrected per gas. A trend, not a calibration.
panels.title: Partial pressure (device sensitivity)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.t AS time, CASE s.mass WHEN 2 THEN '02 H2' WHEN 4 THEN '04 He' WHEN 18 THEN '18 H2O' WHEN 28 THEN '28 N2/CO' WHEN 32 THEN '32 O2' WHEN 40 THEN '40 Ar' WHEN 44 THEN '44 CO2' WHEN 69 THEN '69 CF3 (PTFE)' WHEN 129 THEN '129 Xe' WHEN 132 THEN '132 Xe' ELSE s.mass::text END AS metric, s.pp_mbar AS value
FROM rga_summary s JOIN rga_saves v ON v.file = s.file
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.t) AND s.mass IN ($mass) AND v.recipe IN ($recipe) AND coalesce(v.detector, 'Faraday') IN ($detector) AND s.pp_mbar > 0
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Per Save, each mass over N2/CO at 28. For an air leak O2/N2 (32/28) is about 0.2-0.3 and Ar/N2 (40/28) about 0.01; a 28 with little 32 and 40 is CO or outgassing rather than air.
panels.title: Ratios to m/z 28 (leak check)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.t AS time,
  CASE a.mass WHEN 18 THEN 'H2O/N2 (18/28)' WHEN 32 THEN 'O2/N2 (32/28)' WHEN 40 THEN 'Ar/N2 (40/28)' WHEN 44 THEN 'CO2/N2 (44/28)' WHEN 69 THEN 'CF3/N2 (69/28)' END AS metric,
  a.current_a / b.current_a AS value
FROM rga_summary a
JOIN rga_summary b ON b.file = a.file AND b.mass = 28
JOIN rga_saves v ON v.file = a.file
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.t) AND a.mass IN (18, 32, 40, 44, 69) AND v.recipe IN ($recipe) AND coalesce(v.detector, 'Faraday') IN ($detector)
  AND a.current_a > 0 AND b.current_a > 0
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The slow-control pressure the RGA guards on: emission below 4e-4 mbar, EM below 4e-5 mbar.
panels.title: p105 (guard gauge)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t, $__interval), 'p105' AS metric, avg(value) AS value
FROM meas WHERE channel = 'p105' AND quality = 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(t)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Saved measurements
panels.description: Every Save in the time range. The file is in data/rga/YYYY/ on the SC PC and downloadable from the RGA page; read it with xams_sc.rga_file.load_rga.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.t AS saved, v.recipe, coalesce(v.detector, 'Faraday') AS detector, v.tags, v.comment,
  max(s.current_a) FILTER (WHERE s.mass = 18) AS "I(18) H2O",
  max(s.current_a) FILTER (WHERE s.mass = 28) AS "I(28) N2/CO",
  max(s.current_a) FILTER (WHERE s.mass = 40) AS "I(40) Ar",
  max(s.current_a) FILTER (WHERE s.mass = 69) AS "I(69) CF3",
  max(s.current_a) FILTER (WHERE s.mass = 132) AS "I(132) Xe",
  v.file
FROM rga_saves v LEFT JOIN rga_summary s ON s.file = v.file
WHERE $__timeFilter(v.t) AND v.recipe IN ($recipe) AND coalesce(v.detector, 'Faraday') IN ($detector)
GROUP BY v.t, v.file, v.recipe, v.detector, v.tags, v.comment
ORDER BY v.t DESC
